SELECT wp_id,
    slug,
    '/'::text || slug AS target_path
   FROM posts
  WHERE wp_id IS NOT NULL AND slug IS NOT NULL;

WITH post_base AS (
         SELECT p.id,
            p.title,
            p.content,
            p.date,
            p.slug,
            p.link,
            p.images,
            p.categories,
            p.created_at,
            p.wp_id,
            p.image_url,
            p.excerpt,
            p.author,
            p.tags,
            p.modified,
            p.source,
            p.tree_priority,
            p.space,
            p.content_old,
            p.verified,
            p.verified_at,
            p.verified_by,
            p.ai_addition,
            p.ai_touched,
            p.ai_touched_note,
            p.verify_level,
            p.convergence_score,
            p.convergence_axes,
            p.has_1820,
            p.verify_signature,
            p.has_1820_seal,
            p.ai_number,
            p.share_to_fb,
            p.fb_posted_at,
            p.fb_post_id,
            p.fb_error,
            p.theme,
            p.authors,
            p.axis_pin,
            p.thumb_url,
            p.home_hidden,
            p.cipher_slug,
            (regexp_match(COALESCE(p.content, ''::text), '<iframe[^>]+src=["'']([^"'']+)["'']'::text, 'i'::text))[1] AS iframe_url
           FROM posts p
          WHERE NOT ('טיוטה'::text = ANY (COALESCE(p.tags, '{}'::text[]))) AND NOT ('פורום'::text = ANY (COALESCE(p.tags, '{}'::text[])))
        ), post_media_raw AS (
         SELECT p.id AS post_id,
            'selfhost'::text AS video_kind,
            regexp_replace(m.m[1], '[?#].*$'::text, ''::text) AS media_url,
            NULL::text AS youtube_id
           FROM post_base p
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_matches(COALESCE(p.content, ''::text), '(https?://[^"''[:space:]<>]+\.(?:mp4|webm|m4v)(?:\?[^"''[:space:]<>]*)?)'::text, 'gi'::text) m(m)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT p.id,
            'youtube'::text,
            'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v='::text || m.m[1],
            m.m[1] AS m
           FROM post_base p
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_matches(COALESCE(p.content, ''::text), '(?:youtube(?:-nocookie)?\.com/(?:embed/|watch\?v=)|youtu\.be/)([A-Za-z0-9_-]{11})'::text, 'gi'::text) m(m)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT p.id,
            'vimeo'::text,
            'https://vimeo.com/'::text || m.m[1],
            NULL::text AS text
           FROM post_base p
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_matches(COALESCE(p.content, ''::text), 'vimeo\.com/(?:video/)?([0-9]{5,})'::text, 'gi'::text) m(m)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT p.id,
            'gdrive'::text,
            'https://drive.google.com/file/d/'::text || m.m[1],
            NULL::text AS text
           FROM post_base p
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_matches(COALESCE(p.content, ''::text), 'drive\.google\.com/(?:file/d/|open\?id=)([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)'::text, 'gi'::text) m(m)
        ), post_media_refs AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT post_media_raw.post_id,
            post_media_raw.video_kind,
            post_media_raw.media_url,
            post_media_raw.youtube_id
           FROM post_media_raw
        UNION ALL
         SELECT p.id,
            'legacy_external'::text AS text,
            p.iframe_url,
            NULL::text AS text
           FROM post_base p
          WHERE ('וידאו'::text = ANY (COALESCE(p.categories, '{}'::text[]))) AND p.iframe_url IS NOT NULL AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM post_media_raw r
                  WHERE r.post_id = p.id))
        ), post_rows AS (
         SELECT 'post'::text AS source_type,
            p.id::text AS source_id,
            p.date AS created_at,
            p.modified AS updated_at,
            p.title,
            p.slug,
            r.video_kind,
            r.media_url,
            r.youtube_id,
            p.image_url AS poster_url,
            p.thumb_url,
            'https://sod1820.co.il/post/'::text || p.slug AS page_url,
            p.title AS seo_title,
            p.author AS speaker,
            COALESCE(p.tags, '{}'::text[]) AS topics,
            array_remove(ARRAY[
                CASE
                    WHEN 'מה קורה הבורא'::text = ANY (COALESCE(p.tags, '{}'::text[])) THEN 'mah-kore-habora'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN 'מימד חמש'::text = ANY (COALESCE(p.categories, '{}'::text[])) THEN 'dimension-five'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END], NULL::text) AS series_keys,
            p.cipher_slug,
            COALESCE(p.categories, '{}'::text[]) AS categories,
                CASE
                    WHEN 'וידאו'::text = ANY (COALESCE(p.categories, '{}'::text[])) THEN 10
                    ELSE 20
                END AS placement_priority,
            true AS dedicated_page,
            r.video_kind = ANY (ARRAY['selfhost'::text, 'youtube'::text, 'vimeo'::text]) AS google_indexable,
            r.video_kind <> ALL (ARRAY['selfhost'::text, 'youtube'::text, 'vimeo'::text]) AS needs_review
           FROM post_base p
             JOIN post_media_refs r ON r.post_id = p.id
        ), channel_rows AS (
         SELECT 'channel_update'::text AS source_type,
            c.id::text AS source_id,
            c.created_at,
            c.enriched_at AS updated_at,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(c.seo_title, ''::text), NULLIF(c.text, ''::text), 'סרטון'::text) AS title,
            NULL::text AS slug,
            'selfhost'::text AS video_kind,
            regexp_replace(c.image_url, '[?#].*$'::text, ''::text) AS media_url,
            NULL::text AS youtube_id,
            c.thumb_url AS poster_url,
            c.thumb_url,
            NULL::text AS page_url,
            c.seo_title,
            c.speaker,
            COALESCE(c.topics, '{}'::text[]) AS topics,
            array_remove(ARRAY[
                CASE
                    WHEN c.channel = 'or-geula'::text THEN 'or-geula'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END], NULL::text) AS series_keys,
            NULL::text AS cipher_slug,
            ARRAY[c.channel] AS categories,
            60 AS placement_priority,
            false AS dedicated_page,
            false AS google_indexable,
            false AS needs_review
           FROM channel_updates c
          WHERE c.status = 'live'::text AND c.image_url ~* '\.(mp4|webm|m4v)(\?|$)'::text
        ), home_rows AS (
         SELECT 'home_video'::text AS source_type,
            h.id::text AS source_id,
            h.created_at,
            h.updated_at,
            h.title,
            h.slug,
                CASE
                    WHEN NULLIF(h.video_url, ''::text) IS NOT NULL THEN 'selfhost'::text
                    ELSE 'youtube'::text
                END AS video_kind,
                CASE
                    WHEN NULLIF(h.video_url, ''::text) IS NOT NULL THEN regexp_replace(h.video_url, '[?#].*$'::text, ''::text)
                    WHEN NULLIF(h.yt, ''::text) IS NOT NULL THEN 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v='::text || h.yt
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS media_url,
            h.yt AS youtube_id,
            h.poster_url,
            h.poster_url AS thumb_url,
                CASE
                    WHEN NULLIF(h.slug, ''::text) IS NOT NULL THEN 'https://sod1820.co.il/post/'::text || h.slug
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS page_url,
            h.title AS seo_title,
            NULL::text AS speaker,
            '{}'::text[] AS topics,
            array_remove(ARRAY[
                CASE
                    WHEN h.cipher_slug IS NOT NULL THEN 'cipher'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END], NULL::text) AS series_keys,
            h.cipher_slug,
            '{}'::text[] AS categories,
            30 AS placement_priority,
            NULLIF(h.slug, ''::text) IS NOT NULL AS dedicated_page,
            NULLIF(h.slug, ''::text) IS NOT NULL AS google_indexable,
            false AS needs_review
           FROM home_videos h
          WHERE h.is_active = true AND (NULLIF(h.video_url, ''::text) IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(h.yt, ''::text) IS NOT NULL)
        ), story_rows AS (
         SELECT 'story'::text AS source_type,
            s.id::text AS source_id,
            s.created_at,
            s.created_at AS updated_at,
            s.title,
            NULL::text AS slug,
            'selfhost'::text AS video_kind,
            regexp_replace(s.video_url, '[?#].*$'::text, ''::text) AS media_url,
            NULL::text AS youtube_id,
            s.image_url AS poster_url,
            s.image_url AS thumb_url,
                CASE
                    WHEN s.link ~ '^https?://'::text THEN s.link
                    WHEN s.link IS NOT NULL THEN 'https://sod1820.co.il'::text ||
                    CASE
                        WHEN s.link ~~ '/%'::text THEN s.link
                        ELSE '/'::text || s.link
                    END
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS page_url,
            s.title AS seo_title,
            NULL::text AS speaker,
            '{}'::text[] AS topics,
            '{}'::text[] AS series_keys,
            NULL::text AS cipher_slug,
            '{}'::text[] AS categories,
            70 AS placement_priority,
            s.link IS NOT NULL AS dedicated_page,
            false AS google_indexable,
            false AS needs_review
           FROM stories s
          WHERE s.active = true AND NULLIF(s.video_url, ''::text) IS NOT NULL
        ), all_rows AS (
         SELECT post_rows.source_type,
            post_rows.source_id,
            post_rows.created_at,
            post_rows.updated_at,
            post_rows.title,
            post_rows.slug,
            post_rows.video_kind,
            post_rows.media_url,
            post_rows.youtube_id,
            post_rows.poster_url,
            post_rows.thumb_url,
            post_rows.page_url,
            post_rows.seo_title,
            post_rows.speaker,
            post_rows.topics,
            post_rows.series_keys,
            post_rows.cipher_slug,
            post_rows.categories,
            post_rows.placement_priority,
            post_rows.dedicated_page,
            post_rows.google_indexable,
            post_rows.needs_review
           FROM post_rows
        UNION ALL
         SELECT channel_rows.source_type,
            channel_rows.source_id,
            channel_rows.created_at,
            channel_rows.updated_at,
            channel_rows.title,
            channel_rows.slug,
            channel_rows.video_kind,
            channel_rows.media_url,
            channel_rows.youtube_id,
            channel_rows.poster_url,
            channel_rows.thumb_url,
            channel_rows.page_url,
            channel_rows.seo_title,
            channel_rows.speaker,
            channel_rows.topics,
            channel_rows.series_keys,
            channel_rows.cipher_slug,
            channel_rows.categories,
            channel_rows.placement_priority,
            channel_rows.dedicated_page,
            channel_rows.google_indexable,
            channel_rows.needs_review
           FROM channel_rows
        UNION ALL
         SELECT home_rows.source_type,
            home_rows.source_id,
            home_rows.created_at,
            home_rows.updated_at,
            home_rows.title,
            home_rows.slug,
            home_rows.video_kind,
            home_rows.media_url,
            home_rows.youtube_id,
            home_rows.poster_url,
            home_rows.thumb_url,
            home_rows.page_url,
            home_rows.seo_title,
            home_rows.speaker,
            home_rows.topics,
            home_rows.series_keys,
            home_rows.cipher_slug,
            home_rows.categories,
            home_rows.placement_priority,
            home_rows.dedicated_page,
            home_rows.google_indexable,
            home_rows.needs_review
           FROM home_rows
        UNION ALL
         SELECT story_rows.source_type,
            story_rows.source_id,
            story_rows.created_at,
            story_rows.updated_at,
            story_rows.title,
            story_rows.slug,
            story_rows.video_kind,
            story_rows.media_url,
            story_rows.youtube_id,
            story_rows.poster_url,
            story_rows.thumb_url,
            story_rows.page_url,
            story_rows.seo_title,
            story_rows.speaker,
            story_rows.topics,
            story_rows.series_keys,
            story_rows.cipher_slug,
            story_rows.categories,
            story_rows.placement_priority,
            story_rows.dedicated_page,
            story_rows.google_indexable,
            story_rows.needs_review
           FROM story_rows
        )
 SELECT source_type,
    source_id,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    title,
    slug,
    video_kind,
    media_url,
    youtube_id,
    poster_url,
    thumb_url,
    page_url,
    seo_title,
    speaker,
    topics,
    series_keys,
    cipher_slug,
    categories,
    placement_priority,
    dedicated_page,
    google_indexable,
    needs_review,
        CASE
            WHEN video_kind = 'youtube'::text AND youtube_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'youtube:'::text || youtube_id
            WHEN video_kind = 'vimeo'::text THEN 'vimeo:'::text || regexp_replace(media_url, '.*/'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text)
            WHEN video_kind = 'gdrive'::text THEN 'gdrive:'::text || regexp_replace(media_url, '.*/'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text)
            WHEN video_kind = 'legacy_external'::text THEN 'external:'::text || md5(media_url)
            WHEN media_url IS NOT NULL THEN 'url:'::text || regexp_replace(media_url, '[?#].*$'::text, ''::text)
            ELSE (source_type || ':'::text) || source_id
        END AS asset_key
   FROM all_rows
  WHERE media_url IS NOT NULL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.chat_search_facts(p_query text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 3)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_posts text;
  v_vals int[];
  v_nums text := '';
begin
  -- (1) פוסטים (RAG)
  with toks as (
    select array(
      select w from (
        select regexp_replace(t, '[^א-ת]', '', 'g') as w
        from regexp_split_to_table(coalesce(p_query, ''), '\s+') t
      ) x
      where char_length(w) >= 3
        and w not in ('מה','יש','על','של','את','זה','זו','לי','לך','לו','גם','כי','לא','כן','אבל',
          'הוא','היא','הם','אני','אתה','עם','או','רק','כל','אם','אז','מי','איך','למה','מתי','האם',
          'אין','הכל','ספר','תספר','רוצה','תגיד','בבקשה','אותי','אותך','שלי','שלך','כמה','איזה',
          'הזה','הזאת','עכשיו','תודה','שלום','היי','אולי','צריך','באמת','ממש')
    ) as ws
  ),
  q as (
    select case when array_length(ws, 1) is null then null
                else to_tsquery('simple', array_to_string(ws, ' | ')) end as tsq
    from toks
  ),
  ranked as (
    select p.title,
      left(regexp_replace(coalesce(nullif(p.excerpt, ''), p.content), '<[^>]+>|\s+', ' ', 'g'), 280) as snip,
      ts_rank(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(p.title,'') || ' ' || coalesce(p.excerpt,'')), q.tsq) as rank
    from public.posts p, q
    where q.tsq is not null
      and q.tsq @@ to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(p.title,'') || ' ' || coalesce(p.excerpt,''))
    order by rank desc
    limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 3), 5))
  )
  select string_agg('• ' || title || ': ' || trim(snip), E'\n') into v_posts from ranked;

  -- (2) 🔢 מספר בשאילתה → אינטליגנציית-המספר המלאה (number_dossier), מקור-אמת יחיד
  select array_agg(distinct (m)[1]::int) into v_vals
  from regexp_matches(coalesce(p_query, ''), '\d{2,6}', 'g') m;

  if v_vals is not null then
    select string_agg(d, E'\n\n') into v_nums
    from (select public.number_dossier(v) d from (select distinct unnest(v_vals) as v) t) z
    where d is not null;
  end if;

  return nullif(concat_ws(E'\n\n', nullif(v_nums, ''), v_posts), '');
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cross_source_posts(p_labels text[])
 RETURNS TABLE(label text, slug text, title text, wp_id bigint, via text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
with graph as (
  select t.label, p.metadata->>'slug' as slug, p.label as title,
         nullif(p.metadata->>'post_wp_id','')::bigint as wp_id, 'graph'::text as via,
         row_number() over (partition by t.label order by coalesce(p.weight,3) desc) as rn
  from unnest(p_labels) as t(label)
  join nodes e on e.type='entity' and e.is_active and e.label = t.label
  join edges ed on ed.relation_type='mentions' and ed.to_node = e.id
  join nodes p on p.id = ed.from_node and p.type='post' and p.is_active
             and coalesce(p.metadata->>'slug','') <> ''
),
txt as (
  select t.label, p.slug, p.title, p.wp_id::bigint, 'text'::text as via, p.rn
  from unnest(p_labels) as t(label)
  cross join lateral (
    select slug, title, wp_id, row_number() over (order by (title ilike '%'||t.label||'%') desc, date desc) as rn
    from posts
    where (title ilike '%'||t.label||'%' or content ilike '%'||t.label||'%')
      and slug is not null
    limit 2
  ) p
  where not exists (select 1 from graph g where g.label = t.label)
)
select label, slug, title, wp_id, via from graph where rn <= 2
union all
select label, slug, title, wp_id, via from txt where rn <= 2;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hot_posts_live(days integer DEFAULT 7, lim integer DEFAULT 4)
 RETURNS TABLE(slug text, title text, image_url text, views bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select p.slug, p.title, p.image_url, count(*)::bigint as views
  from public.page_views v
  join public.posts p on p.slug = v.ref
  where v.kind = 'post' and v.created_at > now() - make_interval(days => days)
  group by p.slug, p.title, p.image_url
  order by views desc limit lim;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.post_conversation_projection(p_post_wp_id bigint, p_limit integer DEFAULT 200)
 RETURNS TABLE(source_kind text, source_id text, parent_ref text, author_display_name text, author_is_contributor boolean, body text, reactions jsonb, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_post_id bigint;
begin
  select id into v_post_id from public.posts where wp_id = p_post_wp_id;
  if v_post_id is null then
    return; -- unresolved post_wp_id: never guess a canonical post to attach comments to
  end if;

  return query
  select * from (
    select
      'wordpress'::text as source_kind,
      c.wp_id::text as source_id,
      c.parent_wp_id::text as parent_ref,
      c.author_name as author_display_name,
      false as author_is_contributor,
      c.content as body,
      null::jsonb as reactions,
      c.date as created_at
    from public.comments c
    where c.post_wp_id = p_post_wp_id
      and c.status = 'publish'

    union all

    select
      'community'::text as source_kind,
      rc.id::text as source_id,
      rc.parent_id::text as parent_ref,
      coalesce(rc.author_name, ct.display_name) as author_display_name,
      (rc.author_contributor_id is not null) as author_is_contributor,
      rc.body,
      rc.reactions,
      rc.created_at
    from public.research_contributions rc
    left join public.contributors ct on ct.id = rc.author_contributor_id
    where rc.target_type = 'post'
      and rc.target_id = v_post_id::text
      and (rc.status = 'approved' or rc.author_user_id = auth.uid())
      -- Phase 2.2 integrity fix: never project a visually empty Community reply into the post
      -- conversation. A visible reply whose parent is one of these invisible rows keeps its
      -- parent_ref by id; the WordPress half of this union is unaffected (its own source never
      -- exhibited this blank-payload defect).
      and (
        coalesce(btrim(rc.body), '') <> ''
        or coalesce(btrim(rc.title), '') <> ''
        or rc.image_url is not null
        or jsonb_array_length(rc.media) > 0
      )
  ) unified
  order by created_at asc
  limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 200), 500));
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lang_links_list(p_visitor text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS SETOF language_links
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select * from public.language_links
  where status = 'approved'
     or (p_visitor is not null and p_visitor <> '' and created_by_visitor = p_visitor)
  order by (status <> 'approved') desc, created_at desc
  limit 500;
$function$
